faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What wood and finish are used?
faq.a1: Solid teak (dark tone) and pine (light tone). Finished with matte polyurethane—durable and water‑resistant, with a warm, natural feel.
faq.q2: How do I care for it?
faq.a2: Wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth. No special oiling needed—the polyurethane finish protects the wood for years of use.
faq.a3: Options for 60%, 65%, 75%, TKL, and Full‑size layouts. Please measure your keyboard length (in cm) to ensure a perfect fit.
faq.q4: Can I request a custom length?
faq.a4: Yes. We accept custom orders on a pre‑order basis (~7 days). Contact us via WhatsApp to confirm details.
faq.a5: Orders before 12:00 (GMT+7) ship the same day; after 12:00 ship the next day. Orders after Saturday 12:00 ship on Monday.
